media: real rendered frames plus an owned isolated PulseAudio WAV and a Playwright video of this same session
injections: none: no state injection, debug setter, teleport or config script

mediaTimeline.alignment: approximate; audio and video are separate unsynchronized recordings
mediaTimeline.uncertainty: Offsets are host wall-clock differences between the recorder/context start and the observed gesture. The Playwright video timeline is frame-driven and the parec stream begins only after process spawn plus PulseAudio scheduling latency (unmeasured here). Audio and video are two independent recordings and are NOT muxed or sample-aligned: treat every offset as approximate guidance for seeking (order is reliable, absolute position is not), never as a synchronization claim.
